### Observed differences

- Two activities that never appeared in the earlier window occur in every later case: A01 and A05 each went from 0 of 200 traces to 200 of 200, exactly once per case; A01 sits around the middle of the case (median relative position about 0.6) and A05 at the very end (median position 1.0). [OCC001, OCC002, POS001, POS003]
- In the later window, A03's outgoing transitions lead to A01 in about 45% of cases and A04's in about 52%; in the earlier window A03 led mainly to A06 (about 39%), A02 (about 38%) and A04 (about 23%), and A04 led mainly to A06 (about 74%). [DIR002, DIR003]
- A01's observed outgoing transitions lead to A06 in about 80% of cases, and A06 now leads to A05 in about 84% of its outgoing transitions; before, A06's observed successors (59 transitions) were A02 (about 53%), A04 (about 29%) or A03 (about 19%). [DIR001, DIR005]
- Before, A03, A04 and A06 each occurred without A01 in every trace; in the later window they co-occur with A01 in every trace, with A03 before A01 in about 87% and A04 before A01 in about 69% of traces, and A01 precedes both A06 and A05 in every trace. [REL001, REL002, REL004, REL003]
- A05 is preceded by A06 in every later trace, by A03 in about 98% and by A04 in about 87% of traces, and A01 precedes A05 in every trace. [REL007, REL005, REL006, REL003]
- Distances grew where A01 now lies between activities: A04 followed by A06 within one step fell from about 74% to about 7% (gaps of 2–3 steps now about 93%), and A03–A06 one-step gaps fell from about 40% to about 9%. [LAG003, LAG002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that two activities, A01 and A05, were added to the process as mandatory, once-per-case steps: A01 was inserted between the A03/A04 stage and A06, and A05 was placed after A06 at the end of the case, so the dominant flow changed from A03/A04 leading mainly to A06 (whose observed successors were A02, A04 or A03) to A03/A04 → A01 → A06 → A05. [OCC001, OCC002, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR005, REL003, REL004, REL007, POS001, POS003]

The participation change is direct and complete (0 of 200 vs 200 of 200 traces), and the routing, ordering, positional and gap items all describe the same flow consistently; with 21 qualifying items against roughly 0.13 expected for an unchanged process, chance sampling cannot account for the evidence as a whole. [OCC001, DIR001, REL004, LAG003]

Limitations: most items describe one underlying flow change and are therefore not independent confirmations, and the evidence cannot rule out that the two windows captured a different case mix rather than a modified process — although two activities appearing in all 200 later traces and none of the 200 earlier traces makes pure sampling variation implausible. [OCC001, OCC002]

Other differences: A04 and A06 occupy somewhat earlier relative positions in the later window (A04 mean about 0.68 to 0.47; A06 about 0.83 to 0.72), and in the 29 later traces where A05 has an observed successor it is A04 in about 59% of cases, together with new 4–5-step A03–A04 gaps in about 28% of pairs — suggesting a minority pattern in which work recurs after A05. [POS002, POS004, DIR004, LAG001]
